bactromod.options.title: BactroMod Settings
bactromod.options.gammaMultiplier.desc: Boosts in-game Brightness by set factor.
bactromod.options.nightVision.desc: Toggles the Night Vision status effect.
bactromod.options.pumpkinBlur.desc: Toggles the black texture overlay that strongly limits view when player wears a carved pumpkin.
bactromod.options.fireOffset.desc: Moves fire texture in height. Usually you would select a negative value to move the fire texture down and free up your view.
bactromod.options.shieldOffset.desc: Moves shield in height when in first-person perspective. Usually you would select a negative value to move shield down and free up your view.
bactromod.options.showMapWhileInBoat.des: Allows maps to always be visible when moving in a boat.
bactromod.options.lavaFog.desc: Toggles fog caused by diving into lava.
bactromod.options.powderSnowFog.desc: Toggles fog caused by diving into powder snow.
bactromod.options.blindnessFog.desc: Toggles fog caused by blindness effect.
bactromod.options.darknessFog.desc: Toggles fog caused by darkness effect.
bactromod.options.waterFog.desc: Toggles fog caused by diving into water.
bactromod.options.dimensionBossFog.desc: Toggles dimension fog (e.g. in Nether) or fog caused by bosses.
bactromod.options.renderDistanceFog.desc: Toggles fog at end of render-distance.
bactromod.options.fixShieldRiptideTriden: Fixes the position of a shield in the offhand while using a riptide trident in water or rain.
bactromod.options.ignoreOpGamemodeSwitch: Opens game-mode switcher when pressing F3+F4 regardless of OP status.
modmenu.summaryTranslation.bactromod: A lightweight mod with some game optimizations and features.
modmenu.descTranslation.bactromod: A lightweight mod with some game optimizations and features.
